policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: For the mixed red-and-green goal, finish the green quota before choosing red.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For mixed-color goals, use the matching goal-and-layout preference below to choose which needed color to finish first; do not apply a universal green-first rule. All preference indices use the updated deposit counters after processing the current execution interval.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: For the one-green goal select the initially visible green cube near [81, 153].
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For the one-green goal select the initially visible green cube near [81, 153]. For three blue and two green with the bin near [90, 148], finish green first: select green near [99, 82] or [118, 81] when green_deposited is respectively zero or one, then blue near [61, 171], [112, 152], or [88, 184] when blue_deposited is respectively zero, one, or two. For one red with the bin near [112, 177], select red near [79, 127]. For two red and three green with the bin near [94, 155], finish green first: select green near [68, 178], [71, 75], or [90, 181] when green_deposited is respectively zero, one, or two, then red near [54, 99] or [100, 121] when red_deposited is respectively zero or one. For two blue with the bin near [122, 181], select blue near [91, 163] or [97, 117] when blue_deposited is respectively zero or one. For two red and one green with the bin near [107, 86], finish red first: select red near [74, 98] or [64, 83] when red_deposited is respectively zero or one, then green near [105, 117]. These preferences apply only to approximately matching goals and layouts and select currently observed cubes, not fixed points independent of the scene.
